module.purpose: Provides DOM media embedding for exported editor content by converting canvases, videos, and images into self-contained image data while preserving relevant element attributes.
module.summary: This module traverses rendered DOM descendants and replaces or updates media elements so exported content does not depend on live video frames or external image resources. Canvas and video elements become synchronously decoded images, images receive embedded data URLs, and form controls retain their current values. It uses the owning window for cross-document element checks and recursively processes rendered children.
module.businessContext: Supports reliable export and embedding of editor documents containing media. Failures can produce missing, externally dependent, or visually stale media in exported content.
functions: copyAttrs (~L5-10): Copies all source element attributes onto a target element.
replace (~L12-15): Replaces an original DOM element and returns its replacement.
createImage (~L17-39): Creates and decodes an image with embedded media data.
getCanvasReplacement (~L41-49): Converts a canvas snapshot into an image replacement.
getVideoReplacement (~L51-66): Captures video or poster imagery for replacement.
embedMedia (~L68-95): Embeds media and recursively processes rendered descendants.

moduleContractTests.then: canvas is replaced with an img element whose src is "data:image/png;base64,abc", decoding is "sync", and loading is "eager"

moduleContractTests.scenario: A video frame can be extracted.
moduleContractTests.then: video is replaced with an img element whose src is "data:image/png;base64,frame"

moduleContractTests.scenario: Video frame extraction fails but the video has a poster.
moduleContractTests.then: video is replaced with an img element whose src is "data:image/jpeg;base64,poster"
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the documented fallback ordering for unavailable video frames.

moduleContractTests.then: the same image node has src set to "data:image/jpeg;base64,image", decoding set to "sync", and loading set to "eager"
moduleContractTests.rationale: Ensures image resources are embedded in place without replacing the node.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An input or textarea contains a current value.
moduleContractTests.then: the input has value attribute "hello" or the textarea has textContent "world"
moduleContractTests.rationale: Preserves live form-control state in serialized DOM output.

units.name: copyAttrs

detail.name: copyAttrs
preconditions: source and target are Element objects.
postconditions: For every attribute present on source at invocation, target has the same attribute name and value.
Returns undefined.
invariants: Each source attribute is transferred using its name and value without transformation.
edgeCases: If source has no attributes, target is unchanged.
If target already has an attribute with the same name, its value is overwritten with the source value.
Attributes are processed from the source attribute collection as an array snapshot.

raises: Underlying DOM errors from target.setAttribute, if any.
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Not defined for values that are not Element objects; such values may cause a runtime error.

stateMutations: target's DOM attributes are added or updated.
detail.summary: Copies every attribute from a source DOM element to a target DOM element, preserving each attribute name and value.

specTests.then: The target has id="source" and data-kind="image" attributes with the corresponding values.
The target remains unchanged with class="existing".
The target's class attribute value becomes "new".

units.name: replace

detail.name: replace
preconditions: original and replacement are HTMLElement instances supporting replaceWith.
postconditions: original is replaced in its parent DOM context by replacement.
The returned value is the same object as replacement.
invariants: The replacement element is not cloned; the exact replacement object is inserted and returned.
edgeCases: If replacement is already connected elsewhere, the DOM operation follows replaceWith semantics.
If original cannot be replaced by the DOM environment, the underlying replaceWith failure propagates.
stateMutations: The DOM tree containing original is mutated by replacing original with replacement.
detail.summary: Replaces the original DOM element with the provided replacement and returns the replacement element.

units.name: createImage

detail.name: createImage
detail.signature: async function createImage(doc: Document, dataUrl: string | null, cloneAttributesFrom?: HTMLElement)
preconditions: doc must provide a usable createElement operation for creating an HTMLImageElement.
postconditions: Returns a Promise resolving to the newly created HTMLImageElement.
The returned image has a src attribute set to dataUrl when non-null, otherwise to data:.
The returned image has decoding="sync" and loading="eager".
When cloneAttributesFrom is provided, its attributes are copied to the returned image before the src, decoding, and loading attributes are set.
A rejected image.decode() does not reject the returned Promise.
invariants: The created element is an img element.
The function waits for image.decode() to settle before resolving.
edgeCases: When dataUrl is null, src is set to the literal data: fallback.
When cloneAttributesFrom is omitted, no attribute-copy operation is performed.
When image.decode() rejects, the rejection is ignored and the image is still returned.
If element creation or attribute copying throws synchronously, the error is not caught by this function.

raises: Errors from doc.createElement or copyAttrs are propagated.
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: A decode failure is ignored; the created image is returned.

detail.summary: Creates and asynchronously prepares an image element using the supplied document, source URL, and optional source attributes. It applies eager synchronous decoding and tolerates image decode failures.

specLiterals.role: The created DOM element must use the img tag name.
Fallback src value when dataUrl is null.
Required value of the image decoding attribute.
Required value of the image loading attribute.

specTests.then: The returned image has src="data:", decoding="sync", and loading="eager".
The call resolves successfully with the created image rather than propagating the decode rejection.
Attributes are copied from cloneAttributesFrom, and the returned image has its src set to the supplied data URL with decoding="sync" and loading="eager".

units.name: getCanvasReplacement

detail.name: getCanvasReplacement
preconditions: canvas is a canvas element with an ownerDocument.
postconditions: Returns the result of createImage using canvas.ownerDocument and the canvas data URL when canvas.toDataURL() succeeds.
Returns the result of createImage using canvas.ownerDocument and null when canvas.toDataURL() throws.
invariants: The canvas ownerDocument is passed to createImage in both success and fallback paths.
The function awaits and returns the image creation result.
edgeCases: If canvas.toDataURL() succeeds, its returned data URL is passed to createImage.
If canvas.toDataURL() throws, the error is caught and null is passed to createImage instead.

errorPolicy.returnsOnError: Falls back to createImage with a null data URL when canvas.toDataURL() throws.

detail.ioFormatSpec: Produces an image through createImage(document, dataURL, canvas), where dataURL is the string returned by canvas.toDataURL() or null on serialization failure.
detail.summary: Creates an image replacement for a canvas using the canvas data URL when available, and falls back to an image without a data URL if serialization fails.

specTests.then: createImage is invoked with canvas.ownerDocument, the returned data URL, and the canvas, and the resulting image is returned.
The serialization error is swallowed; createImage is invoked with canvas.ownerDocument, null, and the canvas, and the resulting image is returned.

units.name: getVideoReplacement

detail.name: getVideoReplacement
preconditions: The video argument provides an ownerDocument usable by createImage.
postconditions: On successful frame extraction, returns the image created from the extracted data URL.
If frame extraction fails and the video has a poster, returns the image created from the poster data URL.
If frame extraction fails and no poster is available, returns the image created without image data.
invariants: The replacement image is created using the video's ownerDocument and the video element as inputs.
edgeCases: When video frame extraction succeeds, the poster is not consulted.
When frame extraction fails and video.poster is present, poster conversion is attempted.
When frame extraction fails and video.poster is absent, an image with null image data is returned.
If poster conversion fails after frame extraction fails, the error is not caught by this function and the returned promise rejects.

errorPolicy.returnsOnError: Frame-extraction errors are caught and trigger poster or null-data fallback; errors from poster conversion or replacement creation propagate.

detail.summary: Asynchronously creates an image replacement for a video using a captured video frame when possible, then a poster image, and finally an empty image fallback.

specTests.then: It returns the image created from the frame data URL and does not require poster conversion.
It attempts to convert the poster to a data URL and returns an image created from that data URL.
It returns an image created with null image data.

units.name: embedMedia

detail.name: embedMedia
preconditions: node is an HTMLElement associated with an owner window that provides the relevant HTML element constructors.
postconditions: Canvas and video nodes are processed through their corresponding replacement helpers.
Image nodes have their src attribute set to the resolved data URL or data:, decoding set to sync, and loading set to eager before descendants are processed.
Input nodes have their value attribute synchronized with their current value.
Textarea nodes have their text content synchronized with their current value.
Rendered child elements are recursively processed.
For image nodes, the original node is returned; for canvas and video nodes, the replacement result is returned; other nodes complete without an explicit return value.
invariants: Rendered descendants are processed only after the current node's media or form-control handling completes.
All rendered children are processed concurrently.
An image decode failure does not prevent completion of image processing.
edgeCases: An image with a currentSrc uses currentSrc in preference to src when creating the data URL.
If image conversion returns nullish, the image src attribute is set to data:.
If image decoding rejects, the rejection is ignored and processing continues.
A node that is not canvas, video, image, input, or textarea is left unchanged except that its rendered descendants are recursively processed.
If any recursive child processing rejects, the Promise.all operation rejects.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation is performed; behavior depends on getOwnerWindow, element classification, and rendered-child discovery.
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: No fallback is produced for conversion, replacement, or recursive-processing failures. Image decode failures are swallowed.

stateMutations: Mutates image src, decoding, and loading attributes.
May mutate or replace nodes through the replace helper.
detail.ioFormatSpec: DOM-in-place transformation. Image sources are replaced with data URLs; if conversion is nullish, the exact fallback value is data:.
detail.summary: Embeds media content within a DOM node by replacing canvas and video elements, converting images to data URLs, synchronizing form control values, and recursively processing rendered descendants.

specLiterals.role: Fallback src attribute value when image conversion produces a nullish result.

specTests.when: embedMedia is called on the image.
specTests.then: The data URL is written to src, decoding is set to sync, loading is set to eager, decode is attempted, and the same image node is returned.

specTests.when: embedMedia is called on the image.
specTests.then: src is set to data:, decoding is set to sync, loading is set to eager, and the function still completes successfully with the image node.

specTests.when: embedMedia is called on the parent.
specTests.then: The parent is not directly replaced, and all rendered descendants are processed recursively and concurrently.
